results.description: Combine dictionary-based positive and negative counts to capture net tone. I applied SUGGESTION1 (used multiple datafields fnd91_sentiment2_0 and fnd91_sentiment2_1). SUGGESTION2 (vector ops) not applied because no single vector field exists. SUGGESTION3 (ts_backfill) not needed: both coverages ~0.8664 (>0.6). SUGGESTION4: used high userCount fields (sentiment2_0 userCount=6). Kept KEEP_IN_MINDs: implementation short and uses 2 datafields and <=7 operators. Confidence: 0.70.

Signal = current readability_0 unusually worse or better vs recent history. SUGGESTION1: single strong field fnd91_readability_0 used. SUGGESTION2 not applied (no vector). SUGGESTION3 not needed (coverage 0.8664). SUGGESTION4 applied: high userCount. Kept implementation concise and within operator/data limits. Confidence: 0.65.

Use short-term increase in exposure to topic_4 as an actionable momentum proxy. SUGGESTION1: single topic field fnd91_topic_4 used. SUGGESTION2 not applicable. SUGGESTION3 not needed (coverage 0.7101>0.6). SUGGESTION4: topic_4 has high alphaCount (20) so useful. Respect KEEP_IN_MIND constraints. Confidence: 0.60.

Compare complexity (sentiment2_3) with readability_0 to find filings that are complex but marketed as easy (or vice versa). SUGGESTION1: used two fields. SUGGESTION2 not applied. SUGGESTION3 not needed (coverage ~0.8658). SUGGESTION4: both fields have decent userCount. Implementation adheres to limits. Confidence: 0.55.

High numeric_count relative to word count may signal more quantitative disclosure. SUGGESTION1: combined fnd91_numeric_count and fnd91_measure_4 (word count). SUGGESTION2 not applied. SUGGESTION3 not needed (both coverage 0.8664). SUGGESTION4: measures have good userCount. KEEP_IN_MINDs followed. Confidence: 0.58.

Use raw exposure to topic_18 (topic with many existing alphas) as a thematic alpha. SUGGESTION1: single datafield fnd91_topic_18 used. SUGGESTION2 not applied. SUGGESTION3 not required (coverage 0.668). SUGGESTION4 applied: high userCount/alphaCount (10/12). Implementation compact. Confidence: 0.62.

Short-term spike in fnd91_sentiment1_2 (negative score) signals potential downside. SUGGESTION1: single field used. SUGGESTION2 not applicable. SUGGESTION3 not needed (coverage 0.8658). SUGGESTION4: used field with prior alphas. Implementation minimal. Confidence: 0.66.

Ratio of positive to negative dictionary counts (sentiment2_0 / sentiment2_1) to normalize raw counts. SUGGESTION1 used two fields. SUGGESTION2 not applied. SUGGESTION3 not needed (coverage high). SUGGESTION4 used popular fields. Implementation short and within operator limits. Confidence: 0.63.

Detect abrupt changes in readability using ts_delta on fnd91_readability_2. SUGGESTION1 used one field. SUGGESTION2 not applied. SUGGESTION3 not needed (coverage 0.8664). SUGGESTION4 uses a field with multiple prior alphas. KEEP_IN_MIND observed. Confidence: 0.59.

High exposure to topic_12 indicates concentrated topical focus; use as signal. SUGGESTION1 used fnd91_topic_12. SUGGESTION2 not applied. Coverage high (0.8487) so no backfill. SUGGESTION4: topic_12 has prior alphas. Confidence: 0.60.

High syllable count per word signals complexity; use fnd91_measure_1 and fnd91_measure_4. SUGGESTION1: two fields used. SUGGESTION2 not applied. Coverage high so no backfill. SUGGESTION4: measure fields have userCount. KEEP_IN_MIND respected. Confidence: 0.54.

Raw fnd91_topic_13 is informative (many alphas). SUGGESTION1 used topic_13. SUGGESTION2 not applied. Coverage high (0.8327). SUGGESTION4: alphaCount high. Simple implementation meets constraints. Confidence: 0.61.

Subtract objective score (sentiment1_3) from positive score (sentiment1_1) to find promotional language. SUGGESTION1: used two fields. SUGGESTION2 not applied. Coverage high (~0.8658). SUGGESTION4: fields have prior alphas. Implementation short. Confidence: 0.56.

Elevated fnd91_topic_10 exposure (rare topic) may indicate specific events. SUGGESTION1 used topic_10. SUGGESTION2 not applied. Coverage 0.8007 adequate. SUGGESTION4 moderate use. Implementation minimal. Confidence: 0.50.

Fraction of complex words to total words (measure_2 / measure_4) indicates obfuscation. SUGGESTION1: two fields. SUGGESTION2 not applied. Coverage high. SUGGESTION4 used measure fields. KEEP_IN_MIND satisfied. Confidence: 0.57.

Monitor sudden increases in fnd91_topic_19 exposure as event indicator. SUGGESTION1 used topic_19. SUGGESTION2 not applied. Coverage strong (0.8597). SUGGESTION4 used. Implementation concise. Confidence: 0.52.

Unusually many attachments (fnd91_doccount) may signal substantive disclosure. SUGGESTION1 used single field. SUGGESTION2 not applied. Coverage 0.6578. SUGGESTION3 not necessary. Implementation simple. Confidence: 0.48.

Use fnd91_topic_2 exposure as thematic alpha (coverage 0.8358). SUGGESTION1 used single field. SUGGESTION2 not applied. SUGGESTION4 used (prior alphas exist). Implementation minimal. Confidence: 0.51.

Declining negative dictionary counts (sentiment2_1) could indicate improving outlook. SUGGESTION1 used one field. SUGGESTION3 not needed (coverage 0.8664). SUGGESTION4 applied. Implementation fits limits. Confidence: 0.55.
Normalize fnd91_topic_7 to cross-section using zscore. SUGGESTION1 used topic_7. SUGGESTION4: prior alphas exist. SUGGESTION3 not needed (coverage 0.8597). Implementation short. Confidence: 0.50.

Combine readability_0 and measure_0 (sentence count) to adjust readability per sentence. SUGGESTION1 used two fields. SUGGESTION2 not applied. Coverage high so no backfill. Keeps operators minimal. Confidence: 0.53.
Detect short-term spikes in fnd91_topic_8 exposure. SUGGESTION1 used single field. SUGGESTION3 not required (coverage 0.786). SUGGESTION4 considered. Implementation very short. Confidence: 0.49.

Rising objective score fnd91_sentiment1_6 signals more factual content. SUGGESTION1 used one field. SUGGESTION4: high userCount/alphaCount used. No ts_backfill needed. Implementation compact. Confidence: 0.58.
Use positive zscore of fnd91_topic_11 to flag unusual focus. SUGGESTION1 used topic_11. Coverage 0.7238 adequate so no backfill. Implementation minimal and within limits. Confidence: 0.45.

High adjective count in top category (fnd91_cat0_cnt3) signals promotional language. SUGGESTION1 used one field. Coverage 0.6555 so OK. SUGGESTION3 not required. KEEP_IN_MIND respected. Confidence: 0.47.
Low similarity (fnd91_cat0_metric0_0) to last quarter may signal change. SUGGESTION1 used one field. Coverage 0.6455 borderline but >0.6 so no backfill. Implementation short. Confidence: 0.50.
Track fnd91_topic_14 changes; topic has moderate coverage and prior alphas. SUGGESTION1 used topic_14. SUGGESTION3 not needed. Implementation simple. Confidence: 0.46.
Short filings with many sentences (measure_0 / measure_4) may be terse disclosures. SUGGESTION1 used two fields. SUGGESTION2 not applied. Coverage high. Implementation concise. Confidence: 0.44.
Use ts_zscore on fnd91_topic_16 to capture sudden thematic emphasis. SUGGESTION1 used single field. Coverage 0.7247 adequate. Implementation short. Confidence: 0.48.

High objective relative to negative (sentiment1_3 / (sentiment1_2+1)) suggests balanced factual tone. SUGGESTION1 used two fields. Coverage high. SUGGESTION4 partially applied. Implementation respects limits. Confidence: 0.52.
Normalize fnd91_topic_3 cross-sectionally to spot outliers. SUGGESTION1 used topic_3. Coverage 0.7505. SUGGESTION4 used. Implementation minimal. Confidence: 0.42.
Fraction of long words (measure_3 / measure_4) as obfuscation proxy. SUGGESTION1 used two fields. Coverage high. SUGGESTION4 yes. Short implementation. Confidence: 0.50.

Use ts_backfill for topic_1 (coverage 0.5741 <0.6) then measure change. SUGGESTION1 applied with ts_backfill to improve coverage (SUGGESTION3). SUGGESTION2 not applied. SUGGESTION4 limited. KEEP_IN_MIND maintained. Confidence: 0.38.
Detect rise in fnd91_topic_6 (coverage 0.7078). SUGGESTION1 used single field. SUGGESTION3 not required. Implementation minimal. Confidence: 0.45.
Zscore of positive sentiment model2 (sentiment1_4) to normalize across firms. SUGGESTION1 used one field. Coverage high. SUGGESTION4 present. Implementation short. Confidence: 0.54.
Use fnd91_topic_5 exposure (coverage 0.6646) as signal of targeted disclosures. SUGGESTION1 used single field. SUGGESTION3 not needed. Implementation minimal. Confidence: 0.40.

For fnd91_cat11_sentiment2_3 (coverage 0.6421), ts_backfill then zscore to stabilize. SUGGESTION3 applied to low-coverage category. SUGGESTION1 used one field. SUGGESTION4 minimal. KEEP_IN_MIND observed. Confidence: 0.43.
Short-term delta on fnd91_topic_15 to find novel emphasis. SUGGESTION1 used one field. Coverage 0.6967 so no backfill. Implementation short. Confidence: 0.39.
Use fnd91_sentiment1_9 (objective model3) zscored to find factual spikes. SUGGESTION1 applied. Coverage 0.8658. Implementation compact. Confidence: 0.47.
Zscore fnd91_topic_17 exposure for thematic trading. SUGGESTION1 used one field. Coverage 0.7199 adequate. Implementation minimal. Confidence: 0.41.
Use fnd91_topic_0 exposure (coverage 0.6402) as early warning; zscore normalize. SUGGESTION1 used single field. No vector ops. KEEP_IN_MIND obeyed. Confidence: 0.36.
Use ts_delta of fnd91_cat13_metric0_1 (coverage 0.6483) to detect structural changes. SUGGESTION1 applied. SUGGESTION3 not required. Implementation short. Confidence: 0.44.

Contrast topic_12 and topic_18 exposures to find shifting emphasis. SUGGESTION1 used two fields (keeps to 2). SUGGESTION2 not used. Coverage high for both. Implementation within operator/data limits. Confidence: 0.50.
Short-term spike in fnd91_sentiment1_5 (negative model2) as contrarian signal. SUGGESTION1 used single field. Coverage 0.8658. Implementation concise. Confidence: 0.56.
Monitor ts_delta on fnd91_topic_9 (coverage 0.6916) for event-driven shifts. SUGGESTION1 used field. No backfill required. Implementation within limits. Confidence: 0.37.
Use ts_std_dev of measure_0 (sentence count) to proxy disclosure volatility. SUGGESTION1 used one field. SUGGESTION3 not needed. Implementation simple. Confidence: 0.43.
Subtract readability_0 from topic_16 exposure to spot dense-topic but readable filings. SUGGESTION1 used two fields. No vector ops. Coverage adequate. Confidence: 0.35.
ts_delta on fnd91_cat1_metric0_0 (coverage 0.6015) to find category-level shifts. SUGGESTION1 used field with borderline coverage but >0.6 so no backfill. Implementation short. Confidence: 0.34.
Use raw fnd91_sentiment2_2 (dictionary-based words) zscored to find extreme filings. SUGGESTION1 used single field. Coverage 0.8664. Implementation minimal. Confidence: 0.48.
Spread between topic_19 and topic_7 to identify rotation in themes. SUGGESTION1 used two fields. Both have good coverage. Implementation concise. Confidence: 0.40.
Abrupt increase in sentence count (measure_0) flagged via ts_zscore. SUGGESTION1 used one field. Coverage high (0.8664). Implementation short. Confidence: 0.46.
Use ts_delta on fnd91_topic_13 to capture fast thematic changes (topic_13 has many alphas). SUGGESTION1 used single field. No backfill needed. Confidence: 0.49.
Divide topic_10 exposure by readability_0 to find concentrated topics presented simply. SUGGESTION1 used two fields. Coverage ok. Implementation brief. Confidence: 0.33.
ts_ir (mean/std) of negative sentiment fnd91_sentiment2_1 over window to measure persistence. SUGGESTION1 used one field. SUGGESTION3 unnecessary. Implementation uses ts_ir. Confidence: 0.53.
Subtract topical exposures to detect rotations between themes. SUGGESTION1 used two fields. Kept simple. Confidence: 0.36.

For low-coverage cat12 fields (coverage ~0.576) apply ts_backfill then compare positive vs negative (sentiment1_1 vs sentiment1_2). SUGGESTION3 applied. SUGGESTION1 used two fields. KEEP_IN_MIND satisfied. Confidence: 0.30.
Spread between topic_8 and topic_16 to detect shifting disclosure topics. SUGGESTION1 used two fields. Coverage good. Implementation short. Confidence: 0.34.
Zscore fnd91_measure_2 (complex words) to find unusually complex filings. SUGGESTION1 used one field. Coverage high 0.8664. Implementation minimal. Confidence: 0.45.
For topic_1 (coverage 0.5741) apply ts_backfill to get reliable exposure and use zscore. SUGGESTION3 applied. SUGGESTION1 used single field. KEEP_IN_MIND followed. Confidence: 0.28.
ts_std_dev on fnd91_topic_4 to estimate how volatile focus is on that topic. SUGGESTION1 used single field. Coverage ok. Implementation short. Confidence: 0.39.
Use ts_arg_max on topic_18 to find if current day is max in window (fast spike indicator). SUGGESTION1 used single field; SUGGESTION4 supports. Implementation concise. Confidence: 0.44.

ts_delta of fnd91_sentiment1_7 where available; but coverage low so fallback to sentiment1_4. SUGGESTION1: used sentiment1_4 to stay within high coverage. SUGGESTION3: avoided low-coverage field. Confidence: 0.41.
Relative emphasis ratio between topic_14 and topic_13 to highlight thematic tilt. SUGGESTION1 two fields used. Coverage good. Implementation simple. Confidence: 0.32.

Combine readability_0 and sentiment1_3 to prefer readable factual filings: add(zscore(readability_0), zscore(sentiment1_3)). SUGGESTION1 used two fields. SUGGESTION2 not applied. KEEP_IN_MIND obeyed. Confidence: 0.55.

ts_count_nans on topic_3 to measure data sparsity in window (coverage management). SUGGESTION3 not applied as coverage>0.6; still useful to measure gaps. SUGGESTION1 used one field. Implementation short. Confidence: 0.25.

Multiply topic_7 exposure by negative sentiment fnd91_sentiment2_1 to find topics associated with negativity. SUGGESTION1 used two fields. SUGGESTION4 used high-coverage fields. Implementation concise and within limits. Confidence: 0.48.
Quantile-normalize fnd91_topic_18 to gaussian for cross-sectional comparability. SUGGESTION1 used single field. SUGGESTION4 applied. Implementation short. Confidence: 0.50.
Apply ts_decay_linear to topic_4 to smooth and prefer persistent rises. SUGGESTION1 used single field. SUGGESTION3 not needed. KEEP_IN_MIND followed. Confidence: 0.46.

Highlight filings where objective scores rise while readability worsens: subtract(zscore(readability_0), zscore(sentiment1_3)). SUGGESTION1 used two fields. Implementations kept short. Confidence: 0.34.
Use ts_arg_min on topic_12 to find recent troughs before rebounds. SUGGESTION1 used single field. Coverage strong. Implementation compact. Confidence: 0.31.
ts_zscore of delta of fnd91_sentiment2_0 to capture acceleration in positivity. SUGGESTION1 used one field. Coverage high. Implementation within operator budget. Confidence: 0.57.
Flag high absolute exposure in topic_13 via thresholded zscore. SUGGESTION1 used one field. Implementation kept concise. Confidence: 0.47.
Detect jumps in long-word count (measure_3) using ts_delta. SUGGESTION1 used one field. Coverage high. Implementation short. Confidence: 0.29.
Divide topic_11 by doccount to find topic emphasis per attachment. SUGGESTION1 used two fields. KEEP_IN_MIND respected. Coverage ok. Confidence: 0.27.
ts_delta on fnd91_cat3_metric0_0 to find category-level shifts (coverage 0.6463). SUGGESTION1 used single field. Implementation minimal. Confidence: 0.33.
Use ts_zscore on ts_delta of fnd91_topic_2 to detect rapid topical switches. SUGGESTION1 used one field. Coverage high. Implementation uses 2 ops. Confidence: 0.38.
ts_std_dev on topic_10 to prefer persistent topic presence over noise. SUGGESTION1 used one field. Coverage 0.8007. Implementation concise. Confidence: 0.30.

ts_delta on fnd91_sentiment1_8 if available; fallback use sentiment1_5 which has coverage. SUGGESTION1 used sentiment1_5 to maintain reliability. SUGGESTION3 avoided low-coverage fields. Confidence: 0.36.
Multiply topic_6 by inverse readability to highlight complex topical disclosures. SUGGESTION1 two fields used. SUGGESTION3 not needed. KEEP_IN_MIND obeyed. Confidence: 0.29.
Multiply topic_18 by numeric_count to prefer quantitative topical filings. SUGGESTION1 used two fields. Fields have high coverage. Implementation short. Confidence: 0.51.
Subtract topic_8 from topic_4 to capture rotations between these topics. SUGGESTION1 used two fields. Both have decent coverage. Implementation brief. Confidence: 0.28.
Use ts_ir on readability_2 to find stable vs noisy readability changes. SUGGESTION1 used single field. Coverage high. Implementation minimal. Confidence: 0.40.
Divide topic_7 by negative sentiment sentiment1_2 to flag topics discussed with low negativity. SUGGESTION1 used two fields. Coverage acceptable. Implementation short. Confidence: 0.33.
Cross-sectional zscore of topic_16 to highlight outsized exposures. SUGGESTION1 used one field. Coverage ok. Implementation concise. Confidence: 0.35.
ts_arg_max on topic_13 to flag if current is recent maximum. SUGGESTION1 used one field and operator within limit. Confidence: 0.37.
Divide sentence count by document attachments to find dense attachments. SUGGESTION1 used two fields. Coverage high. Implementation short. Confidence: 0.26.
Backfill topic_1 (low coverage) then subtract topic_6 to detect reliable rotations. SUGGESTION3 applied, SUGGESTION1 used two fields. KEEP_IN_MIND satisfied. Confidence: 0.29.
ts_regression slope of topic_2 vs time to capture trend. SUGGESTION1 used topic_2. SUGGESTION3 not needed. Implementation uses ts_regression minimally. Confidence: 0.31.

Add zscores of sentiment1_1 and sentiment1_4 (two positive measures) to create robust positivity measure. SUGGESTION1 used two fields. SUGGESTION4 used popular fields. KEEP_IN_MIND respected. Confidence: 0.59.
Apply ts_mean on fnd91_topic_9 to smooth noise and use as slow-moving signal. SUGGESTION1 used single field. Coverage adequate. Implementation short. Confidence: 0.27.
Subtract topic_17 from topic_3 to detect shifts in emphasis across related topics. SUGGESTION1 used two fields. Both coverages acceptable. Implementation concise. Confidence: 0.24.
Use reverse(readability_1) since lower readability (harder to read) might be associated with obfuscation. SUGGESTION1 used one field. Coverage high. Implementation minimal. Confidence: 0.49.
Multiply topic_12 by measure_0 to favor topics in substantive filings. SUGGESTION1 used two fields. Coverage high. Implementation short. Confidence: 0.43.
zscore of ts_delta(topic_4) to find significant moves relative to its volatility. SUGGESTION1 used single field. Implementation within operator limit. Confidence: 0.47.
ts_std_dev of fnd91_cat1_metric0_0 to assess category metric instability. SUGGESTION1 used single field. Coverage ~0.6015 borderline. Implementation short. Confidence: 0.22.
ts_zscore of ts_delta(fnd91_topic_14) to detect meaningful shifts. SUGGESTION1 used single field. Coverage ok. Implementation uses 2 ops. Confidence: 0.26.
Subtract topic_13 from topic_18 to find relative emphasis move. SUGGESTION1 used two fields with good prior alpha counts. Implementation concise. Confidence: 0.38.
Use fnd91_sentiment2_4 (complexity model2) zscored to find complex filings. SUGGESTION1 used one field. Coverage 0.8658. Implementation short. Confidence: 0.44.
Divide topic_7 by topic_2 to find relative emphasis between two frequent topics. SUGGESTION1 used two fields. Coverage good. Implementation short. Confidence: 0.30.
ts_arg_min on topic_16 to flag potential rebound opportunities after troughs. SUGGESTION1 used single field. Implementation minimal. Confidence: 0.28.
Divide ts_delta(topic_11) by doccount to get per-document momentum. SUGGESTION1 used two fields. Implementation short and respects operator/data limits. Confidence: 0.21.
zscore of numeric figures per sentence: zscore(numeric_count / (measure_0+1)). SUGGESTION1 used two fields. Coverage high. Implementation within limits. Confidence: 0.41.
Subtract readability_0 from topic_5 to find complex-topic combinations. SUGGESTION1 two fields used. Coverage ok. Implementation brief. Confidence: 0.19.

Add ts_delta of sentiment2_0 and reverse of ts_delta sentiment2_1 to create composite momentum (positivity rise & negativity fall). SUGGESTION1 used two fields. SUGGESTION3 not needed. KEEP_IN_MIND obeyed. Confidence: 0.60.
ts_ir(topic_8, window) to measure information ratio of topical movement. SUGGESTION1 used single field. Coverage ok. Simple implementation. Confidence: 0.23.
Multiply topic_4 exposure by negative sentiment fnd91_sentiment2_1 to prioritize negatively framed topic_4 filings. SUGGESTION1 used two fields. Coverage high. Implementation short. Confidence: 0.49.
Complex words per sentence (measure_2 / measure_0) indicates complexity density. SUGGESTION1 used two fields. Coverage high. Implementation concise. Confidence: 0.35.
zscore of ts_delta(topic_19) to capture sudden thematic movements in topic_19. SUGGESTION1 used single field. Coverage good. Implementation short. Confidence: 0.28.
Multiply topic_2 by doccount to prefer multi-document emphasis. SUGGESTION1 used two fields. Coverage sufficient. Implementation minimal. Confidence: 0.22.
